sloka: तस्य हस्ताद्धतस्याशु कार्मुकं तत् ससायकम् ।निपपात सह प्राणैर्भ्रश्यमानस्य जीवितात् ।। ६.१११.२१ ।।
transliteration: tasya hastāddhatasyāśu kārmukaṁ tat sasāyakam ।nipapāta saha prāṇairbhraśyamānasya jīvitāt ।। 6.111.21 ।।

translations.english: That arrow of Rama, on killing Ravana, soaked in blood, having accomplished the task quietly reentered its quiver.
